description: Land Acquisition - Topo PP 2 and 13 of Akarahediya, Laggala-Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District - Amendments to the notices published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1882/21 of 01.10.2014 by Laggala-Pallegama D/S Division and No. 1943/5 of 30.11.2015 by Matara D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act for the Moragahakanda & Kaluganga Development Project. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (including lot numbers, land names, types, extents, and locations), notification procedures for interested parties, and compensation claims - all of which fall squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
